messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@ks.gov>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@ks.gov, mike.jenkins@statecontracts.com
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: privacy addendum + DPIA outputs for RFP (Section 7)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for responding on the RFP thread. The procurement team needs two items from each shortlisted vendor to complete our compliance packet: 1) a signed privacy addendum (state template preferred) or clearly identified redlines, and 2) a DPIA executive summary that maps the processing in Section 7 to controls and mitigations.

We are a FedRAMP-adjacent procurement — we do not require FedRAMP authorization, but our IT/security office has asked vendors to demonstrate alignment with FedRAMP controls where applicable and to provide retention/audit log details. Also note the RFP calls out a 7-year audit log retention requirement and some student data categories that may be considered directory information or education records under state law.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide a draft redline against our state privacy addendum?
- Deliver a one-page DPIA executive summary scoped to the services in the RFP?
- Share SOC 2 Type II evidence under NDA and any relevant control mappings?

Our timeline is tight: procurement hopes to have final compliance packets by Nov 6 so we can proceed to contract. I attached Section 7 from the RFP for reference.

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement and proposed ETA.

Best,
Sarah Miller
Procurement Manager
Kansas Department of Education

Attachments: RFP-Section-7-Privacy.pdf

Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the Section 7 excerpt. We can do all three items you requested.

Plan:
- Our contracts lead (Marissa) will send a redline of your state addendum within 48–72 hours.
- Our compliance team will produce a one-page DPIA executive summary scoped to the RFP by Oct 27.
- SOC 2 Type II and control mappings are available; we can provide the report under NDA and a control mapping spreadsheet.

We support US-only data residency options and can call out audit/log retention and KMS usage in the addendum. If you have any mandatory language (e.g., specific audit retention window or breach notification timing), please flag it and we will incorporate.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call on Fri Oct 24 to walk through the redline and DPIA scope?

—Karthik

Subject: Draft redline: KS Dept of Education privacy addendum

Sarah / Karthik — attaching a draft redline of the KS state privacy addendum (see highlights). High-level notes below.

Attachments: KS-DOE-Privacy-Addendum-DRAFT-redline.pdf

Redline highlights:
- Data categories: we added a definition list aligned to the RFP (student directory info, assessment results, PII, service telemetry) to make scope explicit.
- Subprocessors: we propose a subprocessors appendix with notification timelines and an option for the state to request removal/alternative controls for specific subprocessors.
- Audit logs & retention: Redwood can commit to producing immutable audit logs and a 7-year retention export upon request; we added language on format and export procedure.
- DPIA obligations: we added a clause committing to provide the one-page DPIA executive summary and to assist the state security officer with reasonable follow-up questions.
- FedRAMP-aligned controls: where the addendum asks for control lists, we mapped common FedRAMP controls to our SOC 2 controls in an appendix (summary only).
- Incident notification: we maintained 72-hour initial notification and proposed a 30-day follow-up report (we can consider state-specific timing if required).

Question for KS team: can you confirm whether the RFP's reference to "student directory information" includes limited data elements only (name, school, grade) or also extended student attributes used in assessment reporting?

If useful, we can pre-populate a short subprocessor list and KMS/region statements. We plan to share the DPIA executive summary and SOC 2 access link in our follow-up.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@ks.gov>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@ks.gov, mike.jenkins@statecontracts.com
Date: Fri, 24 Oct 2025 10:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Draft redline: KS Dept of Education privacy addendum

Marissa — thank you for the quick turnaround and the redline. A few clarifying items from our legal team:

1) We will circulate a vendor SIG/CAIQ-style questionnaire for your security team to complete; see attached. Please return by Nov 3 to support our review.
2) The RFP does reference both "directory information" (limited elements) and a separate assessment dataset used by third parties. For clarity, the assessment dataset includes performance metrics and item-level responses; that will be treated as education records under our policy.
3) The state policy requires an ability to demonstrate audit logs for up to 7 years and produce them in a machine-readable format (CSV or JSON). In addition, the state security officer asked whether Redwood can accept a state-specific clause about periodic DPIAs for major changes in processing.

The procurement deadline remains Nov 6 for the initial compliance packet; final contract negotiation may follow. We appreciate the offers for SOC 2 under NDA and the FedRAMP mapping.

Attached: KS-SIG-Questionnaire-2025.xlsx

Thanks —
Sarah
Procurement Manager, Kansas Department of Education

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@ks.gov>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Oct 2025 14:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Redwood responses: SIG questionnaire, DPIA summary, SOC 2 access

Sarah — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Please find our responses below and attached artifacts. We can also hop on a follow-up call if you prefer to walk through any of the items.

Attachments: DPIA-Executive-Summary-KS-DOE.pdf

Summary of responses (high level):
- SIG/CAIQ: completed; returning the questionnaire as requested (see attached file and workbook comments). We indicated region-specific controls where applicable.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (security + availability scope) — we can share the full report under a standard NDA and provide a control mapping spreadsheet to FedRAMP and common state requirements.
- DPIA: attached is a one-page DPIA executive summary describing purpose, data categories, lawful bases, data flows, risk assessments (residual risk low/medium), and mitigation measures (encryption at rest/in transit, KMS-backed keys, access controls, logging, and retention policy consistent with RFP).
- Data residency / SCCs: for state data we can restrict processing and storage to US regions (primary and failover). SCCs are supplied only when international transfers occur; if the state anticipates transfers outside the US, we can provide SCCs or equivalent transfer safeguards.
- HIPAA: we are not a HIPAA-covered entity; if PHI is anticipated, we will need to evaluate additional BAAs or scoping adjustments.
- Audit logs: we confirm capability to export audit logs in CSV/JSON for a 7-year window and can provide an automated export on request; we also propose a secure S3 export option under a signed request process.

Next steps we propose:
1) We will post the SOC 2 NDA link and the DocuSign DPA link by EOD tomorrow.
2) Marissa will incorporate the 7-year retention/export language into the redline and add a clause for periodic DPIAs triggered by major processing changes.
3) If you need the DPIA to be longer than the one-page summary, we can expand to a full DPIA within 5 business days upon request.

Links / access:
- SOC 2 access (NDA): https://redwood.ai/security/ndalink
- DPA (DocuSign): https://docusign.com/relink/KS-DPA-2025
- DPIA summary (drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/ks-doe/dpia-summary

Let us know if the state security officer would like a short walkthrough call; we're available Tue-Wed next week.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
